palettePort: Historical 55-entry extraction retained for source parity and provenance. The revision picker uses 37 applicable curated treatments plus disabled Native Glyph: 20 new themes, 5 distinctive source color paths and 12 retained source treatments. Source grading and finite/True Color behavior remain authoritative.

specialModes.nativeglyph: No equivalent: these canonical bitmap masks have no intrinsic colors. The option is identified and disabled rather than bypassing depth.
specialModes.mooburst: Palette and luminance treatment retained. Cow bitmap cameo and associated audio are omitted: replacing canonical masks or injecting audio would violate this instrument.

licensing: Video64 MIT notice retained. ANSI Tube currently has no LICENSE file; its author Shael Riley explicitly authorized inclusion in Video32 and public publication of this repository. This publication does not change the upstream repository's licensing.

releasedBaseline.userObservation: Installed, tried, working and liked. Hardware, physical stereo, capture cleanup and sustained performance were not independently specified or qualified.

polygonSpaces.adaptations: Footprint extrusion, static sector/portal reconstruction, fixed neighborhood layouts and sampled terrain; point fabrics and guided rails. Per-source hashes and limits in the manifest.

sphericalVideo.projection: 360° equirectangular source viewed through a 180° hemisphere. Not native VR180; no depth reconstruction. Native VR180 dataset researched but gated.
